plan_01.note: Underside in flight, gear up. Oblique view, treated as an affine picture of the planform: nose, tail and both wing tips fix the map. semi_span is the wing semi-span over the fuselage length (0.371), found from the same picture with the fin tip as the out-of-plane point.

side_07.note: Long-lens side view in flight, gear down, missile on the wing station. Nose tip and the centre of the nozzle exit fix the map.
